name: Bethuel (Nahor's son, Rebecca's father)
title: Rebecca's father and Aramean
summary: Bethuel was the son of Nahor and Milcah, and nephew of Abraham. He was the father of Rebekah and Laban, and lived in Aram-Naharaim (Mesopotamia). His daughter Rebekah became the wife of Isaac and thus a matriarch of the people of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Bethuel's birth is mentioned
keyEvents.description: Bethuel is mentioned as the eighth and youngest son of Nahor and Milcah, Abraham's brother and sister-in-law.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's servant arrives
keyEvents.description: Abraham's servant comes to Bethuel's hometown to find a wife for Isaac, and meets Rebekah at the well.

keyEvents.title: Consent to Rebekah's marriage
keyEvents.description: Bethuel and Laban give their consent for Rebekah to go with Abraham's servant to become Isaac's wife, acknowledging that this is from the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Bethuel identified as an Aramean
keyEvents.description: Bethuel is described as an Aramean from Paddan-Aram, which links his family to the Aramean people of Mesopotamia.
